title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.Prime.coprime_factorial_of_lt
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.Prime.coprime_factorial_of_lt` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n < p → p.Coprime n.factorial

evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- prime_coprime_factorial_of_lt 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.prime_coprime_factorial_of_lt[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `declare_prime_coprime_factorial_of_lt` (`nat_prelude/prime_dvd_factorial_lcm.rs`) admits `Nat.prime_coprime_factorial_of_lt` through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate. `Coprime` has no separate name over `Nat` in this prelude (matching `coprime_of_lt_prime`'s own convention); it is spelled `gcd p n! = 1` directly. Induction on `n`, `p` and the primality hypothesis held fixed: at `n = 0`, `factorial 0 == 1` (defeq), and `gcd p 1 = 1` unconditionally (`gcd_dvd_right` + `eq_one_of_dvd_one`); at `n = succ k`, the induction hypothesis is weakened from `succ k < p` to `k < p` (`le_succ` + `le_trans`), `coprime_of_lt_prime` (flipped by `coprime_symmetric`) gives `gcd p (succ k) = 1` directly from `succ k < p`, `coprime_mul_of_coprime` combines the two coprimality facts, and `factorial_succ` (`n! == n_prev! * succ n_prev`, defeq) identifies the product with `factorial (succ k)`.
evidence.supports: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n < p → p.Coprime n.factorial
